devicePurposes.purpose: Traverses the EOAT horizontally between the pick position and the place position, moving through an in-between position and blending (rounding) the corner with the Z move for smooth motion.
Raises and lowers the EOAT at pick and place — fast down to the transition point, slow into pick/place, slow back up to the transition point, then fast to retract.
Grips the part at pick and releases it at place; no sensors, so it runs on the standard adjustable close/open delay timers.

Description: Two-axis servo pick and place with pneumatic gripper (timer only) - picks a part and places it with rounded-corner, fast/slow transition motion.

## Devices

## MACHINE SPEC (mechanical intent — compile the coordination)

Station purpose: Servo pick-and-place station that picks a part with a pneumatic gripper and places it at a second position using coordinated horizontal and vertical servo axes.

### Device purposes
- Horizontal_Axis: Traverses the EOAT horizontally between the pick position and the place position, moving through an in-between position and blending (rounding) the corner with the Z move for smooth motion.
- Vertical_Axis: Raises and lowers the EOAT at pick and place — fast down to the transition point, slow into pick/place, slow back up to the transition point, then fast to retract.
- Part_Gripper: Grips the part at pick and releases it at place; no sensors, so it runs on the standard adjustable close/open delay timers.

### Outcome rules (verbatim — each one needs a reachable path in the program)
- WHEN: E-stop, fault, or any recovery of the station -> DO: Run the same recovery every time: check Z first, then decide based on whether a part is held..
- WHEN: Z is not at a safe position during recovery -> DO: Move Z up to the retract/home position before any horizontal motion..
- WHEN: A part is held at recovery -> DO: Move to the place position and wait for the place sequence..
- WHEN: No part is held at recovery -> DO: Move to the pick position and go get a part..
- WHEN: Pick comes up empty -> DO: Not detectable — the gripper is timer-based with no sensors, so the station assumes the part is gripped and continues the cycle without faulting..
